label: Are you filing for bankruptcy under Chapters 7, 11, or 13?
why: Always "Yes" (on_state yes) for a DigniFi Chapter 7 filer, but never ticked, so Part 4 reads as unanswered.

label: What kind of debt do you have? primarily consumer / not primarily consumer
why: Required, and it decides whether lines 8-9g apply; the debtor's answer is never collected or bound.

label: Copy your monthly expenses from line 22c of Schedule J
why: Empty constant; the expense total is sent to 9a instead.

label: Student loans. (Copy line 6f.)
why: Empty constant. This is the most common special category for consumer filers.

label: Taxes and certain other debts you owe the government. (Copy line 6b.)
Death or personal injury while intoxicated; separation/divorce obligations; pension/profit-sharing debts
why: Empty constants. 9a, the domestic-support box, holds the expense total instead.
